thread.title: Czech President Appoints New Justice Minister Amid Political Crisis
thread.title_full: Czech President Appoints New Justice Minister Amid Political Crisis

author: NDT Bureau
title: Czech President Appoints New Justice Minister Amid Political Crisis
text:
• Czech President Petr Pavel appointed Eva Decroix as the new justice minister on Tuesday.
• Decroix replaces Pavel Blažek, who resigned on May 30 amid a political crisis related to a bitcoin scandal.
• Blažek's ministry accepted a donation of bitcoins and sold them for nearly 1 billion Czech koruna ($46 million) earlier this year.
• Blažek stated he was unaware of any wrongdoing but resigned to protect the four-party coalition government led by Prime Minister Petr Fiala.
• Fiala expressed appreciation for Blažek's resignation and believed he acted with goodwill.
• Blažek was a close ally of Fiala in both the government and the Civic Democratic Party.
• Eva Decroix, the new justice minister, is also from the Civic Democratic Party.
• Decroix announced plans to order an independent investigation into the ministry's activities regarding the bitcoin case.
• President Pavel emphasized that public trust in institutions and the state is at stake.
• The bitcoins were donated by an individual previously convicted of drug dealing and other crimes, raising questions about the donation's origins.
• Opposition parties have accused Blažek of potential money laundering due to the unclear origins of the bitcoins.
• The opposition is demanding the resignation of the entire government and plans to request a parliamentary no-confidence vote, potentially in late June.
• The national police's organized crime unit is investigating the scandal.
• The political crisis occurs just months before the parliamentary election scheduled for October 3-4.
• The main opposition ANO (YES) party, led by former Prime Minister Andrej Babiš, is predicted to win the upcoming election.
